# eurodns_record_set (Data Source)

One RRset (all records of a name and type) of a EuroDNS zone. Fails if it does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eurodns_record_set" "mx" {
  zone = "example.com"
  host = "@"
  type = "MX"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Host relative to the zone, `@` for the apex.
- `type` (String)
- `zone` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<zone>/<host>/<type>`.
- `ttl` (Number)
- `values` (Set of String)
